DISTAR_ICE_CAT_DESC: The measured surface temperature of [From.GetName] is in the hundreds of degrees, despite its frozen surface. What could be causing these discrepancies?
crashed_ship_asteroid_category_desc: A vessel of some kind has crashed into the surface of this asteroid. Wreckage from the craft can still be found within the impact crater.
origin_asteroid_category_desc: The material composition of this asteroid differs significantly from its neighbors. It likely has a different origin than the other bodies of this asteroid belt, and should be investigated more closely.
debris_asteroid_category_desc: The surface of this asteroid is littered with metallic debris. Most of it appears to originate from starships of many different designs.
emissions_asteroid_category_desc: Strong energy emissions of an unknown origin make this asteroid stand out from the rest of its peers in this crowded asteroid field.
hatch_asteroid_category_desc: A small docking hatch leading to the interior of this asteroid is visible at the rim of a small crater on its surface. The hatch was likely concealed once, but it has since been exposed by micrometeorite impacts.
collision_asteroid_category_desc: This asteroid recently suffered an impact from another body within the asteroid belt, which resulted in a slightly changed orbit and a massive crater on the surface.
station_asteroid_category_desc: A small space station of some kind has been built in a stable orbit around this asteroid. It appears deserted.
life_asteroid_category_desc: We are picking up life signs coming from somewhere within the interior of this asteroid. This definitely warrants a closer investigation.
object_gasgiant_category_desc: Sensor echoes have indicated the presence of some kind of unidentified object deep within the atmosphere of this gas giant.
moon_gasgiant_category_desc: One of the small moonlets orbiting this gas giant has been identified as a promising mining site. A more thorough survey will have to be conducted to determine whether a mining operation would be feasible or not.
life_gasgiant_category_desc: Life signs have been detected coming from inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. Could it indicate the presence of some kind of biosphere?
storms_gasgiant_category_desc: Massive storms are visible in the upper atmosphere of this gas giant. It might be worth the effort to study them in more detail.
aerostat_gasgiant_category_desc: Some kind of unknown structures are floating in this gas giant's upper atmosphere. They appear to be using aerostatic lift to remain buoyant.
cargo_gasgiant_category_desc: A small cargo pod has been left to drift in space above this gas giant. It has been captured by the planet's gravity well, and will eventually be pulled into its atmosphere.
debris_gasgiant_category_desc: There is a significant amount of debris in orbit around this gas giant. Most of it appears to come from long lost starships of various configurations.
impact_uninhabitable_category_desc: A colossal impact crater hints that something big collided with the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] once.
energy_uninhabitable_category_desc: We briefly detected some unusual energy readings emanating from this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. It might have been a glitch in our systems, or it could be a sign of something more.
signal_uninhabitable_category_desc: By chance, we stumbled upon a faint alien signal during the survey of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The source appears to be a small object in orbit. The signal contains no message - could it be a distress transponder?
asteroid_uninhabitable_category_desc: A class-12 asteroid orbits this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The small planetoid's orbit appears far too stable for its presence to be a natural occurrence.
solar_uninhabitable_category_desc: An abandoned ship has been left to drift aimlessly above this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The massive sails protruding from its hull suggest that it relied on solar power to function.
life_toxic_category_desc: Despite the toxic content and high pressure of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s atmosphere, strong life signs have been detected coming from its surface.
life_frozen_category_desc: At first glance this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] does not seem capable of supporting living beings, but nevertheless we have detected life signs emanating from somewhere beneath its frozen surface.
life_barren_category_desc: We have detected life signs coming from somewhere beneath the barren and lifeless surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. What manner of organism could possibly live there?
station_uninhabitable_category_desc: As this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] was surveyed, a small nearby space station used its orbital thrusters in a vain attempt to hide from our Science Ship. What are they hiding?
battle_uninhabitable_category_desc: A large amount of ship debris can be found in orbit around this [Root.GetPlanetMoon], possibly the remnants of some kind of massive fleet action.
shipyard_uninhabitable_category_desc: An ancient orbital shipyard drifts in silence above this world. It has suffered significant battle damage, and entire sections of the facility are missing.
inhabited_toxic_category_desc: This toxic and lifeless world appears to have once been inhabited by a moderately advanced pre-space civilization. The ruins of their cities are still strewn across the surface.
writing_uninhabitable_category_desc: There is significant scarring on the surface of this world in a pattern that cannot be natural. From orbit, the massive rifts look almost like writing.
beacon_uninhabitable_category_desc: We are receiving a weak signal from the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The source appears to be some kind of tracking beacon.
mountain_uninhabitable_category_desc: Efforts to map the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have identified a strange mountain range in the southern hemisphere. It does not appear to have formed naturally.
object_uninhabitable_category_desc: A small rectangular object on the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] is deflecting all scanning beams like a mirror. Our sensors are unable to determine its material composition.
signal_gasgiant_category_desc: We are picking up what may be a faint transmission coming from somewhere deep inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. Could someone - or something - be trying to communicate?
terminal_gasgiant_category_desc: A small and otherwise insignificant moon orbiting this gas giant appears to be on a trajectory that will soon result in a collision with its primary.
AST_WAVELENGTHS_1_DESC: The asteroid [Root.GetName] is emitting some form of radiation in controlled bursts. Is someone - something - trying to communicate with us?
AST_DEBRIS_FIELD_1_DESC: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].
HBL_LUSH_PLANET_1_DESC: [Root.GetName] is exceptionally green, and preliminary scans indicate that there might be several articles of interest on the surface.
UHB_ANCIENT_RUINS_1_DESC: Impressive structures litter [Root.GetName]'s surface, practically begging for some archaeological work.
GEN_PLAYGROUND_DESC: Impressive structures litter a small area on the surface of [Root.GetName], practically begging for some archaeological work.
HBL_MUSIC_1_DESC: There is a pattern of unusual sonic activity on [Root.GetName].
GAS_ZRO_ICE_DESC: It seems [Root.GetName] is lacking the hydrogen and helium to be classified as a proper gas giant and is, in fact, an ice giant.
TOX_PURPLE_RAIN_DESC: [Root.GetName]'s toxic biosphere gives the planet a unique color scheme.
FROZ_BASE_DESC: Sensors pick up unexpected activity from an isolated point on [Root.GetName]'s frozen surface.
FROZ_BASE2_DESC: Sensors pick up unexpected activity from an isolated point on [Root.GetName]'s arctic surface.
TROP_PETS_DESC: Irregular patterns of movement have been detected within the dense tropical undergrowth of [Root.GetName].
PROJ_MOON_DESC: According to preliminary scans, [Root.GetName] is exhibiting several strange properties and gives readings that are not at all in line with what one would expect from a planet of this type...
SEA_DESC: Vaguely-defined shapes swirl with the currents in [Root.GetName]'s vast oceans.
MOLTEN_BASE_DESC: Sensors pick up rhythmic movement on the hellish surface of [Root.GetName].
LEVELED_DESC: [Root.GetName] seems to exhibit one, and only one, interesting geological feature...
DIMENSIONAL_POCKET_DESC: The debris field which [Root.GetName] is part of roils and swirls under the influence of unknown forces.
HAB_CORN_DESC: Optical scans indicate that the surface of [Root.GetName] is unusually verdant in places.
HAB_MAT_DESC: Backscattering spectrometry sensors indicate the presence of valuable substances in the planet's crust.
ATM_ANOMALY_DESC: Atmospheric readings from [Root.GetName] do not match simulated projections.
FRBR_GRIMACING_DESC: Repeated scans of [Root.GetName]'s surface give inconsistent sensor readings, almost as if the planet itself was in a constant state of upheaval.
FROZ_ILLUMINATED_DESC: Inexplicable optical phenomena play across the surface of [Root.GetName], clearly visible from space.
GAS_CLOUDY_DESC: The atmospheric patterns of [Root.GetName] are highly atypical for a gas giant of modest size.
GAIA_MOVE_DESC: As a Gaia-class planet, [Root.GetName] is expected to teem with life...
FROZ_BOX_DESC: Scans indicate the presence of a foreign, alien-made object on one of [Root.GetName]'s many frozen mountain tops.
CONT_SIGNS_DESC:
[Root.GetName]'s surface appears heavily pockmarked, which is not unusual.

What is unusual is the regular shape of the scars, irregularly distributed. This is unlikely to be the result of meteorite impacts.
AST_CRATER_DESC: [Root.GetName] is home to a number of exquisite impact craters. However, something breaks the visual uniformity in one of the larger craters...
BAR_COLONY_DESC: Optical sensors isolate a cluster of shapes on the barren surface of [Root.GetName] that could be buildings.
TOX_MAT_DESC: Backscattering spectrometry sensors indicate the presence of valuable substances beneath [Root.GetName]'s noxious clouds.
AST_CLUSTER_DESC: An unusually deliberate, geometric configuration of minerals drifts through the debris belt by [Root.GetName], and is possibly of alien origin.
GAEA_CHECKERED_DESC: Visual scans of [Root.GetName]'s surface reveal a grid pattern seemingly covering the entire planet.
GEN_ABANDONED_SHIP_DESC:
A cursory scan of [Root.GetName] yields surprising results.

Something seems to be scanning us back...
GEN_DESERT_DESC: The atmosphere of [Root.GetName] is extremely thin, and yet something not unlike wind seems to agitate the seas of sand that make up its surface.
TOX_STRUCTURES_DESC: Somewhere beneath [Root.GetName]'s unctuous clouds, unnatural structures silhouette themselves against the toxic surface.
TROP_WOODS_DESC: The surface of [Root.GetName] is dominated by particularly impressive-looking trees.
HOLE_RADIATION_DESC: Sensors pick up unusual readings in the vicinity of [Root.GetName] - readings that are hard to explain being this close to a black hole.
UHB_BUOY_DESC: A wavering signal haunts [Root.GetName], though it does not seem to originate from the planet's surface.
GAIA_RECORD_DESC: [Root.GetName]'s verdant plains are quiet, save for a weak but steady beacon signal.
CRYSTAL_MANUFACTORY_DESC: An old, seemingly abandoned structure looms over [Root.GetName], an otherwise unremarkable asteroid.
TROP_BIOLOGY_DESC: The initial data gathered from the tropical forests of [Root.GetName] indicate that something is out of the ordinary.
AST_MINING_DESC: Initial analysis of the asteroid's composition points towards potentially interesting finds.
GEN_DERELICT_SHIP_DESC: Our initial scans have caught an irregular signal reminiscent of our own distress patterns.
GEN_LOST_CARGO_DESC: While scanning the asteroid belt our science team found some sort of irregularity.
GEN_OLD_WAR_DESC: The mineral composition of [Root.GetName] does not match projections.
SUN_RAYS_DESC: We have detected odd radiation that our Science Officer demands to investigate.
WAT_PLANET_DESC: Scans of [Root.GetName] return subtle readings of something beneath the surface.
COLD_RESEARCH_DESC: Our Science Officer has found an anomaly. It will require extensive probing, but could garner a substantial find.
SUN_TEAPOT_DESC: Scanning the star unveils a small object in rapid orbit. Its small size and high velocity make it difficult for our sensors to isolate.
DES_BURIED_DESC: The desert planet [Root.GetName] seems to conceal some buried secrets.
AST_GEAR_DESC:
Observing the massive asteroid [Root.GetName], we have found...

Something. Further investigation is warranted.
TROP_CONDITIONS_DESC: [Root.GetName] appears to hold something of interest deep within its dense jungles.
ARID_SENSOR_DESC: We have detected something out of the ordinary on the arid [From.GetPlanetMoon]. It seems like somebody has been here before us. Further investigation is needed.
CON_BIOLOGY_DESC: The forests on this planetoid bear promises of interesting finds.
TOX_PLANET_DESC: There appears to be deliberately-crafted structures on the planet's surface, pointing toward a past long forgotten.
DES_PLANET_DESC: The scorching heat of [Root.GetName] is within the expected range. However, there is more unusual data still being collected by our team. Further study is needed before a final report can be filed.
NUKE_PLANET_DESC: The nuclear wasteland is evidently a sign of a previous civilization. Our scanners are picking up activity at certain locations that we should investigate.
ARID_PLANET_DESC: The [From.GetPlanetMoon] is not the most welcoming of places, but if our initial scans are any indication it could hold some valuable resources.
rogue_moon_category_desc: Initial scans of [Root.GetName] indicate unexpected differences to its parent planet.
terraforming_candidate_category_desc: This barren and lifeless world is showing signs of once having supported a biosphere.
STH_aMatterOfTime_category_desc: An unknown source of chroniton particles has been detected in the vicinity of [From.GetName].
STH_ancientCapsule_category_desc: While studying [Root.GetName] sensors have been detected what appears to be an ancient capsule of familiar design in orbit. How it found itself in orbit of [Root.GetName] is a mystery.
STH_ancient_dna_category_desc: One of our deep space scouts has picked up signs of a crashed ship, which requires further investigation.
STH_arsenalOfFreedom_category_desc: Arriving at [From.GetName] we've received a signal from the surface...
STH_changelingObelisk_category_desc: Sensors have detected evidence of alien ruins on the surface of [From.GetName].
STH_chroniton_pulses_1_category_desc: Sensors have detected an usual series of chroniton pulses originating from the surface of [From.GetName].
STH_de_declaratem_category_desc:
Sensors have detected what appears to be a ship trapped just below [FromFrom.GetName]'s event horizon. 

A static warp bubble could potentially be employed to return the vessel to normal space.
STH_gamestersOfTriskelion_category_desc: A preliminary scan of [From.GetName]'s surface has revealed potentially large concentrations of duranite ore. A survey of the planet will be necessary to confirm the scale of these deposits.
STH_gravity_category_desc: The sensor readings of this system seem to be slightly off from normal parameters with the main disturbance originating from here.
STH_iconia_probe_category_desc: A distress call from a nearby vessel has been picked up in the vicinity of one of the planets in the system. The planet appears to be ruined.
STH_innerLight_category_desc: A small alien vessel, most likely a probe, has been detected in orbit of [From.GetName]. Initial scans cannot positively identify it.
STH_memorial_category_desc: Long distance scans of the surface of [From.GetName] suggest there could be substantial Dilithium deposits present.
STH_mirrorMirror_category_desc: We have found a planet worth exploring, but an ion storm is quickly moving in.
STH_orbital_signal_source_1_category_des: Sensors have detected an object of indeterminate size in orbit of [From.GetName].
STH_pahvo_music_category_desc: A mysterious signal sounding almost like an alien melody has been detected from a planet in the Pahvo system.
STH_qless_category_desc: Scans of [ROOT.GetName] show a far greater variability in the gravitational field than would be expected of an asteroid of this size and type. Such readings are normally associated with valuable exotic-matter crystalline deposits.
STH_samaritan_snare_category_desc: In orbit of the lifeless planet [Root.Planet.GetName] we've detected a drifting ship sending out a distress signal.
STH_secondChance_category_desc: There is an upcoming, brief window of opportunity to retrieve scientific data from an abandoned research station on [From.GetName].
STH_shades_of_grey_category: Rich flora and fauna on a habitable planet
STH_shades_of_grey_category_desc: An unusually diverse ecosystem has been detected on this planet. To further explore the planet´s suitability for a colony a thorough survey of such life should be carried out to check for possible risks and also for opportunities to use this ecosystem for our advantage.
STH_silence_category_desc: Attempts to scan this black hole have failed as it doesn't seem to contain any matter at all or expel any form of radiation.
STH_silver_blood_category_desc: Our sensors have identified a potential deuterium source on a planet. However the exact amount and the ease of getting access to that potential source need further investigation as the conditions on the planet are harsh and hostile to most forms of life.
STH_sleepingDogs_category_desc: After launching a Class V probe we have detected a damaged ship in [From.GetName]'s atmosphere. The vessel appears to be in distress.
STH_strangeNewWorld_category_desc: From orbit [From.GetName] appears to be a standard M class world with no sign of intelligent life forms. The ship's science officer recommends a ground survey to assess suitability for colonisation.
STH_theCrossing_category_desc: Unusual subspace readings have been detected in orbit, apparently unconnected to any observable phenomena.
STH_theSilentEnemy_category_desc: Arriving at [From.GetName] we've detected unusual, intermittent subspace readings.
STH_theSkinOfEvil_category_desc: A shuttlecraft exploring [From.GetName] has crashed. Sensor readings are unclear, but there appears to be something moving near the crash site.
STH_theTerratinIncident_category_desc: Arriving at [From.GetName] we've received a signal from the surface...
STH_the_android_category_desc: Scans of the surface suggest this world was once inhabited.
STH_the_chase_category_desc: Trace DNA strands found nearby appear to bear resemblance to other species found within the galaxy.
STH_the_hundred_category_desc: [From.GetName] appears to possess no unusual properties, however an extensive survey will be needed to confirm this.
STH_the_royale_category_desc: Pieces of what appears to be some old space ship have been found in orbit of this gas giant.
STH_the_ship_category_desc: An alien warship has crashed on the surface of [Root.GetName].
STH_twisted_category_desc: Long range scans have detected a strange anomaly, recommendation is to send a ship to investigate.
STH_underground_signals_1_category_desc: Sensors have detected potential signs of an ancient civilisation on the surface of [From.GetName].
STH_vaadwaur_colony_1_category_desc: [From.GetName] is littered with the remains of several ancient cities, apparently destroyed several centuries ago by orbital bombardment.
ship_out_of_time_1.desc:
The chroniton pulses observed from orbit have been localised to a single source, several kilometres below the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. 

After several days of analysis, scientists from the [Root.GetName] have been able to partially scan through the distortion bubble around the source of the chronitons and have detected what appears to be a [Root.Owner.GetName] vessel surrounded by rock.
sth_baku_village_duckblind_category_desc: A joint venture to investigate the mysterious properties on the planet Ba'ku.
sth_chase_2_dig_site_category_desc: A fragmented message encoded within the DNA strands points to an inhabited world.
sth_chase_3_dig_site_category_desc: Combined astrometrics scans are pointing to a fragment of what was once an inhabited planetoid.
sth_chase_dig_site_category_desc: A dying archaeologist left behind random number blocks, which are theorised to be compatible DNA strands from across the galaxy. Another strand may be located here.
sth_colony_flag_category_desc: Our scans have detected the faint trace of some of our earliest space-age technology on this world.
sth_derelict_ship_category: Distress call picked up on sensors
sth_derelict_ship_category_desc: Our listening posts have picked up the distress call coming from a vessel, as of yet there has been no response to any of our attempts to contact the ship.
sth_iconian_dig_site_01_category_desc: Our scientists based on this planet have detected an unusual signal from the old Iconian Ruin dig site.
sth_iconian_dig_site_02_category_desc: Geologists have detected unusual seismic activity in a region with no previous record of such events. The activity appears to uncovered a previously unseen dig site.
sth_iconian_dig_site_03_category_desc: Local archeologists have uncovered the potential ruins of a former Iconian site of interest. We should investigate.
sth_iconian_dig_site_04_category_desc: A faint energy signature is emanating from the surface of this world. We should investigate more thoroughly.
sth_iconian_gateway_dig_site_category2_d: A faint energy signature is emanating from the surface of this world, which appears completely uninhabited. We should investigate more thoroughly.
sth_iconian_gateway_dig_site_category_de: A faint energy signature is emanating from the surface of this world, which appears completely uninhabited. We should investigate more thoroughly.
sth_military_complex_dig_site_category2_: Autonomous drones appear to guard a large facility on the planet below, which appears completely uninhabited. We could investigate more thoroughly.
sth_military_complex_dig_site_category_d: Autonomous drones appear to guard a large facility on the planet below, which appears completely uninhabited. We could investigate more thoroughly.
sth_site_orb_of_emissary_category_desc: A mysterious vision compells us to visit a remote world in search of answers.
stone_of_gol_1.desc:
An ancient device called the 'Stone of Gol' was conceived on Vulcan during the turbulent times before the Time of Awakening.

Finding the first piece is of vital importance.
stone_of_gol_2.desc:
An ancient device called the 'Stone of Gol' was conceived on Vulcan during the turbulent times before the Time of Awakening.

Finding the second piece is of vital importance.
stone_of_gol_3.desc:
An ancient device called the 'Stone of Gol' was conceived on Vulcan during the turbulent times before the Time of Awakening.

Finding the third piece is of vital importance.
sword_of_kahless_1.desc: An abandoned base in our own system may hold the key to the location of the Sword of Kahless.
sword_of_kahless_2.desc: Dense jungle hides an abandoned medical facility that may help us locate the Sword.
sword_of_kahless_3.desc: An ancient ocean research station is our next point of call on the quest for the Sword.
sword_of_kahless_4.desc: We've located one of the last Hur'q colonies in this part of the galaxy. This may be our last option to locate the Sword.
sword_of_kahless_5.desc: Evidence suggests that the Hur'q hid a treasure trove of stolen artefacts here. Is the Sword among them?
tropical_borg_category_desc: The initial data gathered from the tropical forests of [Root.GetName] indicate something of interest may be found on further investigation.
undine_space_anomaly_category_desc: Scouting sensors have identified a mysterious electrical charge disrupting Fluidic Space.
vaadwaur_ruins_1.desc:
After scanning the ruins on and under the surface from orbit, a number of intact underground chambers have been identified. 

A full investigation may reveal the fate of the civilisation that once populated the planet.
STH_crystalline_jewel_desc: Very faint gravimetric readings detected from the surface of the planet.
abronath_1_relic_world_site_desc: Strange sensor nullzones lacking in all organic material have appeared on the planet below.
abronath_2_relic_world_site_desc: A large breach in the crust of this planet does not appear natural.
abronath_3_relic_world_site_desc: A large artificial spire that has toppled to the ground lies upon the surface.
iconia_world_site_desc: The site of an ancient civilisation, above which a distress signal emanating from a stricken vessel can be heard.
pahvo_music_site_desc: An alien spire emitting a beautiful lyrical sound.
sth_site_landing_flag_category_desc: Scientists have discovered the potential site of our first landing on this world. A team has been sent to investigate and uncover the site of our ancestors greatest triumphs.
